description: Swargadeo Purandar Singha, last crowned Ahom king, middle-aged Tai-Ahom monarch, dignified oval face, thin drooping mustache, gold-and-crimson conical Ahom crown, silk muga-yellow royal robe with jewelled collar, solemn regal expression, 1830s dynastic revival
Angami Zapu Phizo, Naga nationalist leader, late thirties, lean angular hill-tribe face, short cropped black hair, plain dark buttoned jacket, intense determined stare, austere 1940s frontier setting

Bishnu Prasad Rabha, Assamese revolutionary artist, late twenties, expressive lively face, wavy swept-back hair, simple cotton kurta with a folk gamosa over the shoulder, bohemian fiery expression, 1930s leftist
Tarun Ram Phukan, veteran Assam Congress leader, late fifties, broad kindly face, greying mustache, white khadi cap and homespun kurta, calm patient elder statesman expression, 1930s
Ambikagiri Raichoudhury, Assamese nationalist poet, fifties, gaunt intense face, flowing greying hair and beard, plain white dhoti-kurta with a gamosa, burning patriotic gaze, 1930s
Jyoti Prasad Agarwala, Assamese filmmaker and poet, mid thirties, refined handsome face, neat side-parted hair and thin mustache, tailored jacket over kurta, artistic thoughtful expression, 1930s
Lakshminath Bezbaroa, elder Assamese literary giant, seventies, full white beard and mustache, round spectacles, traditional turban and shawl over kurta, wise venerable expression, early 20th century
Maniram Dewan, 19th-century Ahom noble and tea pioneer, forties, aristocratic face, curling mustache, ornate Ahom nobleman's turban and jewelled silk robe, shrewd enterprising expression, mid 1800s

Sukaphaa, legendary 13th-century Tai founder-king of the Ahoms, mature warrior-king, strong Tai features, topknot under an ornate golden Tai crown, gold-trimmed ceremonial silk robe, majestic founding-ancestor expression, medieval

Lachit Borphukan, 17th-century Ahom general, thirties, resolute martial face, thin mustache, plumed Ahom war-helmet, lamellar armour over silk, sword at side, commanding battlefield expression, Saraighat era

Rani Gaidinliu, young Naga priestess-rebel woman, early twenties, striking hill-tribe face, black hair with traditional Zeliangrong beaded ornaments and shawl, defiant fearless expression, 1930s hill uprising
